long_biography.plain_text:
A two-person venture became the starting point for Barr's expansion of Hollingsworth. Strategic mergers beginning in 1991 broadened its capabilities, and customer relationships led to joint ventures as the business moved beyond transportation into integrated supply-chain work. The Dearborn-based enterprise became a certified minority provider supporting manufacturing and distribution clients.

The operating model combines order fulfilment, kitting, packaging, assembly and warehouse management with freight services. Barr has remained closely involved as the owner and chairman, including backing a large Michigan expansion intended to add capacity and employment. Through affiliated Native American Logistics, the group also developed non-asset-based logistics across North America.
